title: Structured diff between two recorded runs
description: clozn.analysis.run_diff.compare_runs()'s output: what changed between run_a and run_b across identity, context, generation settings, and output. `differences` is exhaustive over every dimension the differ actually examined -- a dimension both runs agreed on is simply absent, never emitted as a no-op entry. `differences[].rank` is a PRESENTATION-ONLY sort key (a static priority over dimension categories, documented in `ranking`) and is structurally separate from `findings[]`: rank never appears on a finding, and a finding's `status` never appears on a difference. `findings[].status` is the only evidence-strength field in this document and is capped at 'observed'/'correlated' unless a controlled replay actually demonstrates causation ('causally_supported'). Differences under an `identity.ext.<namespace>` this differ has never seen (a facet owned by a feature it does not know about) appear only in `differences`, never folded into a `findings[]` classification -- a differ with no semantic model of a facet has no business claiming it explains anything.

comparison_selection.description: Which reference/candidate pair was chosen and why. Automatic modes exclude internal child runs unless explicitly opted in.

summary_axes.description: Fixed plain-language top summary. Each axis reports changed, unchanged or unavailable; this is a change-state view, not evidence strength.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when this comparison was computed (not when either run happened).

ranking.description: Documents the static category order used to assign differences[].rank -- not a scoring function computed from this run pair's actual behavior, just the named constant so a reader (or a future replay result) can see and contest it.

privacy_limited.description: True when at least one dimension could only be compared by hash/token-count because full content was unavailable on one or both runs (a legacy/light-capture-tier run, or -- once feature 06 ships graduated privacy modes -- a restrictive retention policy). Never a reason to omit the dimension; see each such difference's own note.

dimension.description: Dot-path identifying what was compared, e.g. 'identity.model_sha256' or 'identity.ext.adapter.strength'. Namespaces under identity.ext are contributed by identity_providers this differ does not know the meaning of -- their dimension strings are still well-formed dot-paths, just not ones this schema enumerates.

kind.description: 'unavailable' means the dimension could not be honestly compared (missing evidence on one or both sides, not a same-value match). 'diff_failed' means comparing this one dimension raised -- isolated to this entry, never the whole document.

value_a.description: Any JSON value, or absent when run_a did not carry this dimension.

value_b.description: Any JSON value, or absent when run_b did not carry this dimension.

rank.description: Presentation-only sort position from the static category order in `ranking.order` (lower sorts first / 'more likely to matter'). Never an evidence-strength claim -- see the schema description.

evidence.description: Supporting detail for this one difference (e.g. an embedded model_diff.diff_runs() fragment for an output-dimension entry). Empty array, never omitted, when there is nothing beyond value_a/value_b.

note.description: Free-text honesty caveat for this entry, e.g. why it is 'unavailable' or what a diff_failed exception was.

status.description: The roadmap's evidence-before-narration vocabulary. Without a replay, the strongest allowed value is 'observed' or 'correlated' -- 'causally_supported' requires an intervention (see the replay planner).

summary.description: One human-readable sentence derived from the dimensions below, e.g. 'The model changed.' Never contains a claim stronger than `status`.

dimensions.description: Which differences[].dimension entries this finding was derived from, so a reader can trace the claim back to raw evidence.
